scenes.text: Imagine remodeling your home, knocking down a basement wall, and suddenly staring into a massive, pitch-black tunnel.
He didn't just find a hidden room; he discovered a massive, ancient underground city carved eighteen stories deep into the earth.
It had ventilation shafts, schoolrooms, churches, and even heavy stone doors that could only be locked from the inside to keep invaders out.
Would you spend a single night sleeping down there?
